name: Denta
long_description:
Denta is dental insurance. As a full stack carrier, Denta makes insurance 25% cheaper by selling plans directly to employers and processing claims instantly with AI.

Dentistry is my dad's life's work. Over the past 20 years, he went from being a normal dentist to fully owning ten practices. During that time, he put me to work, first answering phones, then building software.

While at Dartmouth, I sold the software to over 210 practices, but the problem felt small. The best software in the world couldn't protect the dentists I sold to or the patients whose calls I answered from the mounting pressure of insurance companies. Everyone knows how bad health insurance is, dental insurance is sadly the same.

In the US, dental insurers collect $100B per year in premiums, 25% of which goes to brokers, administrators, and outdated IT systems. Despite the $25B in spend, it still takes insurers three weeks to pay claims with paper checks that Denta can pay electronically in seconds.

Denta will insure every American, sparing patients and dentists the $25B burden of dealing with legacy carriers.
